_comment: Fixtures for the offline recognition provider (plantdoctor.recognition.mode=mock).
These labels are NOT predictions. They are fixed answers that let a reader follow
the workflow upload -> route -> label -> knowledge lookup -> log without holding
credentials for the commercial recognition services.
Accuracy figures in the paper were measured with the remote provider. Nothing computed from
this file may be reported as recognition accuracy.
Keys of defaultByCropType are the category keys of InsectCropType.

_notes.aliasFallback: corn_borer_alias.jpg returns an alias (玉米钻心虫) rather than a canonical name, to demonstrate that knowledge linkage falls back to zh_alias_name.
_notes.unmatchedLabel: unknown_lesion.jpg returns a label with no knowledge record, to demonstrate a successful recognition whose knowledge lookup is unmatched. Such a request is logged with knowledgeMatched=false and must not be counted as a successful diagnosis.
